shots.focal_element: Orange 'F' map pin on an isometric line-drawn floor plan, then the 'Animation styles' popover next to it
shots.transition_other: Continuous camera reframe from the previous canvas view (no visible cut; frame starts wider then pushes closer)
shots.typography: Small UI sans-serif (Inter-like, low confidence), medium-weight title, regular-weight sentence-case list items with small leading icons; map pins carry single uppercase letters in a regular geometric sans
shots.what_happens: On a grey isometric floor-plan canvas with selected yellow lettered pins, the camera pushes in while the cursor moves to the orange F pin, clicks it, and an 'Animation styles' popover (Position, Scale, Rotation, Opacity) appears; the cursor hovers Position, which highlights.
shots.build_rebuild: Render an SVG isometric floor plan with circular letter pins, animate a camera scale-up toward pin F, move a cursor sprite onto it, then pop in a small white shadowed menu card with four icon+label rows and highlight the first row on hover.

shots.focal_element: The full floor-plan map card where all pins rise into 3D standing map pins
shots.typography: Left-edge text is cropped: a heavy condensed uppercase sans headline on a yellow highlight block, a bold sentence-case subhead and a bold uppercase label; a small level switcher shows numerals 3, 2, 1
shots.what_happens: The view pulls out to reveal the map is part of a museum-style poster layout (cropped headline, photo of an orange geodesic dome); the flat letter pins all extrude upward into standing pin markers with small ground shadows while level '2' is active in the floor switcher.
shots.build_rebuild: Pull the camera back from the pin closeup to the full page layout, then stagger each pin's translateY upward by ~20px while scaling in a thin stem and a soft ellipse shadow beneath it.

shots.focal_element: Dark phone mockup with a selected hero image card reading 'CANYON CREW MEETUP'
shots.transition_other: Scene change from the museum map layout to an orange backdrop with a phone mockup between 0:26.0 and 0:26.5; exact transition style not visible at 2 fps
shots.typography: Hero title in a dotted/segmented pill-shaped pixel display face, uppercase; card title in regular sans, sentence case; location and time in uppercase monospace with wide tracking; date badge in monospace
shots.what_happens: A dark event-app phone screen sits centered on a flat orange background; its hero image (motion-blurred cyclist with 'CANYON CREW MEETUP') is selected with blue handles and an AI sparkle button beside it; the phone drifts up and the cursor approaches the sparkle button.
shots.build_rebuild: Place a rounded dark phone frame centered on a solid orange stage, draw a blue selection rectangle with square corner handles around the hero image, add a blue sparkle icon button at the top-right, and slowly translate the phone upward while a cursor eases toward the button.

shots.focal_element: AI prompt input field where a prompt is typed above the selected hero image
on_screen_text: Create a glitchy type animation, staggering the shapes.
shots.typography: Prompt in regular sans (Inter-like, low confidence), sentence case, with freshly typed characters briefly tinted blue before settling to black; hero title in dotted pixel display face, uppercase
shots.what_happens: The camera zooms in past the phone frame to the selected image; an empty prompt box opens and the text 'Create a glitchy type animation, staggering the shapes.' types on character by character, then the cursor clicks the blue send arrow.
shots.build_rebuild: Scale the scene up toward the selection, pop in a white rounded prompt card with a '+' and a blue round send button, type the prompt string at ~15 chars/s with the newest characters coloured accent-blue fading to black, then move the cursor onto the send button and press.

shots.focal_element: The selected hero image card in a generating state with a spinning AI sparkle icon
shots.transition_other: Prompt card dismisses and the view reframes onto the image card alone (not clearly visible at 2 fps)
shots.typography: Dotted pill-segment pixel display face, uppercase, wide letterforms, two centered lines
shots.what_happens: With the prompt sent, the image card sits isolated on a dark canvas inside a blue selection outline while a soft light sheen sweeps across it and the sparkle icon rotates, signalling the AI is generating.
shots.build_rebuild: Show the image card in a blue outline on a dark background, rotate the sparkle icon continuously, and sweep a diagonal white gradient mask across the card at reduced opacity as a 'generating' shimmer.

shots.focal_element: The generated glitch type animation playing above a keyframe timeline
shots.transition_other: Sparkle icon resolves into a checkmark, then the view jumps closer to the image with a timeline panel sliding up beneath it
shots.typography: Hero title in dotted pill-segment pixel display face, uppercase, assembling from scattered dashes; timeline ruler in small regular grey sans numerals
shots.what_happens: A checkmark confirms generation, then the glitch animation plays: the title's dash segments scatter and resolve into 'CANYON CREW MEETUP' as a blue playhead scrubs across a timeline of keyframe diamonds and clip bars; the cursor then selects one clip bar (turns blue) and drags its end to shorten it.
shots.build_rebuild: Split the title into per-segment dash shapes and stagger them in from random x offsets with brief opacity flicker over ~1.2s, synced to a playhead moving across a 0-1.6s timeline below, then animate a cursor selecting a grey clip bar (fill to blue) and dragging its right edge leftward.
